title: Reordering items with the HTML drag and drop API
when: Items in a list or grid must be reordered or moved between groups by dragging (playlists, priorities, photo order), with a keyboard alternative.
prompt:
Goal: Native drag and drop reordering with a clear drop indicator, a keyboard path that does the same, and saved order.
Steps:
1. Set draggable="true" on items with a visible handle; on dragstart call dataTransfer.setData("text/plain", id) and set effectAllowed = "move".
2. On dragover of the list call preventDefault() (required to allow a drop) and compute the insert index from pointer Y against item midpoints.
3. Show one insertion line at that index, cleared on dragleave, drop and dragend.
4. On drop read the id, move it in the state array, re-render, then persist the new order.
5. Keyboard: each item has Move up and Move down buttons (or Alt+Arrow on a focused handle); keep focus on the moved item.
6. Announce "Moved Item 3 to position 1 of 5" in a role="status" region; touch screens lack these events, so the buttons are the mobile path.
Quality bar:
- Order changes only on drop, never mid drag.
- Keyboard and pointer give identical results.
- The new order survives a reload.
Pitfalls:
- Forgetting preventDefault on dragover, so drop never fires.
- Reading dataTransfer data during dragover, where it is protected.
- Dragging as the only way to reorder.
Verify:
- [ ] dragover calls preventDefault.
- [ ] Move buttons have names and type="button".
- [ ] Status region announces moves.
- [ ] Order is saved after each change.
Output: js/reorder.js exporting enableReorder(list, { onChange }), plus the item markup with handles and move buttons.

examples.input: quero arrastar as músicas para mudar a ordem da playlist
examples.output: draggable rows with insertion line, Move up and down buttons, "Moved to position 2 of 9" status
